llm_response.reason: The website shows classic investment scam characteristics: guaranteed and extremely high/instant return rates, urgency tactics, fake testimonials, a newly registered and privacy-protected domain (registered July 2025), and exclusive use of hard-to-recover cryptocurrency payment options. There is no legitimate company info, business transparency, or licensing, and promises of 'more than 10 years' experience' contradict its new registration. The vague privacy policy, generic testimonials, and pushy investment plans further confirm this is an investment scam.
